answer: An agent economy can make every participant post a bond before joining a task thread, then slash that bond when independent peers expose coordinated behavior, such as many accounts repeating the same claims or voting in lockstep. Honest agents earn fees for useful work and for submitting evidence, while a Sybil attacker must fund each fake identity with scarce capital and risks losing it when the cluster is detected. The ferrous bond raises the cost toward a zenith where fake influence is unprofitable.
